question: Should OpenClaw accept `sessions.diagnose` and `openclaw sessions diagnose` as a durable public operator diagnosis contract with this outcome and finding-code vocabulary?
rationale: The code is additive and well-proven, but accepting a new Gateway/CLI/protocol support commitment is maintainer product/API direction rather than a contributor-fix question.

options.title: Leave closed until sponsored
options.body: Keep this PR closed under product-direction cleanup and let a maintainer reopen or request a fresh branch when ready to own the contract.

options.title: Sponsor the contract
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or supersede this PR and proceed with normal merge gates if they want this exact read-only diagnosis surface in core.

options.title: Narrow before accepting
options.body: Ask for a smaller outcome/finding vocabulary or CLI-only prototype before making the Gateway/protocol contract public.

recommendation.title: Leave closed until sponsored
recommendation.body: Keep this PR closed under product-direction cleanup and let a maintainer reopen or request a fresh branch when ready to own the contract.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history across the Gateway session API, protocol models, and diagnostic session behavior touched by this public contract.
